type: AMENDMENT - supersedes exactly one clause of T38_PREREG.json: ladder_rule.fit_restriction. Every other field of T38_PREREG.json stays in force unchanged.
approval: Blake Jones via parent agent, ruling t218u, 2026-11-25 1:06 PM CT: freeze Amendment 1

supersedes.old_text: drop L from the N-fit iff gain_L < gain_M, gain = BPB_1ep - BPB_4ep (L gains less from 4x data than M, i.e. L is data-limited)

rule.gain: gain_{arm,rung} = mean BPB_1ep - mean BPB_4ep for that arm and rung (fwedu32 test bpb_corpus, the T-38 primary metric).
rule.a_drop_condition: Drop L from the PRIMARY N-fit only if BOTH (1) gain_M - gain_L >= 2 * SE_diff AND (2) the one-sided Welch test of gain_M > gain_L has p < 0.01. Direction is gain_M > gain_L only; gain_L > gain_M never drops L.
rule.b_se_and_df: SE_diff = sqrt(s2_M1/n_M1 + s2_M4/n_M4 + s2_L1/n_L1 + s2_L4/n_L4), where s2 is the sample variance over seeds of each cell. All available seeds are used: n_M4 = 5 (Stage 1, seeds 13,21,34,55,89); n_M1 = n_L1 = n_L4 = 3 (seeds 13,21,34). df is the 4-cell Welch-Satterthwaite df = SE_diff^4 / sum_c ((s2_c/n_c)^2 / (n_c - 1)). Seeds are not paired across cells for this rule.
rule.c_symmetric_domain: The condition is evaluated separately for P and for H. If it fires for either arm, L is dropped for BOTH P and H, so the primary alpha_H - alpha_P contrast always uses the same rung set for both arms.
rule.d_always_report: The full 5-rung fit (XS, S, M, M+, L) including L is always reported alongside, whether or not L is dropped from the primary fit.
rule.scope: Only decides which rungs enter the primary N-fit. It never decides which runs are launched (Stage 3 still runs unless stage3_stop fires) and never changes per-cell PASS/KILL verdicts or Holm.

data_state_at_freeze.statement: No Stage 2 or Stage 3 data existed at frozen_ct. Checked: 0 terminal records and 0 autolaunch audit events for any Stage 2/3 plan (sweep-M+, XS, S-1ep/4ep, M+, M-1ep, sweep-L, L).
data_state_at_freeze.honest_note: Stage 1 (M-4ep) data exists for the finished plans listed above, and one more is in progress. Of this rule's four inputs, only the M-4ep cell comes from Stage 1: it feeds gain_M through mean and s2 of M-4ep. M-1ep, L-1ep and L-4ep are Stage 2/3 cells with no data yet. The rule's form (2*SE_diff AND p<0.01, n_M4=5) was drafted at 9:20 AM CT, before any T-38 run started, and only that form is frozen here. No Stage 1 value was looked at to choose it.

reason: Under the original strict inequality, if L and M gain equally from 4x data, the rule fires with probability about 0.5 from seed noise alone. The 2*SE AND p<0.01 rule bounds that at 1% (one-sided) and matches the evidence bar of every other T-38 rule.
